result.summary: Found 3 issues: a broken/missing image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section, a cut-off restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row, and minor visual inconsistency in card image styles.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads correctly or provide a fallback image for restaurants without photos.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its name truncated.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container or card width so the card is either fully visible or clearly indicates scrollability (e.g., partial peek with visual cue).

issues.description: Inconsistent visual style between the illustrated/icon-based images (Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers) and the broken placeholder image, creating a jarring visual inconsistency across restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image treatment across all cards, using consistent illustration style or real photography with proper loading states.
